instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after end-to-end evidence exists.

features.description: All public, auth, dashboard, skill, account, and shared UI routes are inventoried with current-state screenshots, theme notes, route owners, and UI debt.
steps: Run the baseline command set and record results.
Capture desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844 screenshots for every route listed in PRD.md.
Record route owners, shared UI entry points, theme behavior, loading behavior, and blockers in the phase report.
features.evidence: VGUI-00 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-00-baseline-ui-audit-and-inventory-report.md. UI baseline summary: product-audit-2026-06-17/global-ui/baseline/summary.json with 54 route checks, 10 scenario checks, and 0 failures.
features.notes: Baseline is capturable and safe to use for VGUI-01. Exploratory edits in src/index.css and src/pages/Home.tsx remain unaccepted until VGUI-01/VGUI-02.

features.description: The global token system, app shell, theme initialization, skeletons, and shared component rules support a light-first learning workbench and a readable non-black dark mode.
steps: Update global tokens and shell rules using existing CSS and component boundaries.
Verify public and dashboard shells in light, dark, and system themes.
Prove route switching does not show a full-screen black or blank fallback.
features.evidence: VGUI-01 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-01-design-tokens-and-app-shell-report.md. Theme matrix: product-audit-2026-06-17/global-ui/vgui-01-theme/summary.json with 32 checks and 0 failures.
features.notes: Light-first tokens, readable dusk dark mode, pre-paint theme initialization, root backgrounds, and quiet skeletons are in place. VGUI-02 can use these shared rules for public/auth polish.

features.description: Public, auth, onboarding, legal, pricing, sample, and word-of-the-day surfaces read as an English learning product instead of an AI SaaS template.
steps: Update public and auth route UI within existing route and auth semantics.
Verify guest and authenticated states where the route supports both.
Capture screenshots proving no black SaaS hero, no clipped CTA, no nested interactive control, and no accidental mixed-language copy.
features.evidence: VGUI-02 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-02-public-and-auth-surfaces-report.md. Public/auth matrix: product-audit-2026-06-17/global-ui/vgui-02-public-auth/summary.json with 40 checks and 0 failures.
features.notes: Public/auth surfaces preserve auth, billing, and legal semantics. Pricing remains fail-closed; BrandMark and concrete Today-task wording are aligned across public entry surfaces.

features.description: Today, Review, Practice, Chat, Vocabulary, and Analytics share one learning-workbench hierarchy and preserve the learning feedback loop.
steps: Update core dashboard routes and shared learning components.
Verify Practice first wrong attempt does not reveal the answer, retry-correct is recovered, and second wrong or reveal shows the answer.
Capture desktop and mobile route evidence for task clarity, feedback states, empty states, and no horizontal overflow.
features.evidence: VGUI-03 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-03-dashboard-core-learning-flow-report.md. Learning-flow regression: product-audit-2026-06-17/global-ui/vgui-03-learning-flow-v3/summary.json with 118 checks and 0 failures, including seeded multiple-choice retry/reveal and listening retry/reveal browser interactions.
features.notes: Practice first wrong attempts keep answers hidden, retry-correct is recovered, second wrong reveals answers, and dark dashboard surfaces are no longer near-black. VGUI-04 should continue module-specific cleanup.

features.description: Reading, Listening, Grammar, Pronunciation, Writing, Exam, Learning Path, Leaderboard, Memory, Settings, and Profile meet the same UI quality bar as the core dashboard.
steps: Update the module routes within their existing feature boundaries.
Verify active, empty, loading, error, completion, and account-save states where applicable.
Capture desktop and mobile evidence that each route has one clear primary action and no old cockpit or nested-card pattern.
features.evidence: VGUI-04 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-04-skill-modules-and-utility-screens-report.md. Extended learning-flow regression: product-audit-2026-06-17/global-ui/vgui-04-modules-v2/summary.json with 142 checks and 0 failures, including Exam, Learning Path, Memory, Leaderboard, light/dark/system, desktop/mobile, and retry/reveal interactions.
features.notes: Old stored non-light theme preferences migrate once back to light. Manual dark mode remains available as a readable low-light surface. Module emerald/white/dark hardcoding was cleaned across Exam, Memory, Vocabulary, Analytics, Review, Pronunciation, Chat, UpgradePrompt, BrandMark, CoachReviewRail, and DashboardLayout.

features.description: The full global UI upgrade is proven by automated checks, screenshot contact sheets, theme checks, learning-flow checks, and a release report.
steps: Run lint, i18n, build, full tests, UI regression, and learning-flow regression.
Generate desktop and mobile contact sheets for all scoped routes.
Write the release report with known risks, blockers, rollback plan, and deployment recommendation.
features.evidence: VGUI-05 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-05-regression-evidence-and-release-gate-report.md. Full validation passed: lint, i18n, build, 103 test files / 810 tests, final UI regression 64 checks / 0 failures, final learning-flow regression 142 checks / 0 failures. Vercel production deployment dpl_AmbxY5xomBkp4i3thgGBwKBFW6Vg is ready and aliased to https://www.uuedu.online.
features.notes: Production frontend smoke passed for public pages, and production bad-token smoke observed 0 refresh-token requests. features.description: The 2026-06-20 Apple-inspired Liquid Glass request is converted into a current route, effect, accessibility, performance, and execution contract that covers the full app.
steps: Research current Apple, MDN, Chrome, and web.dev guidance relevant to Liquid Glass, backdrop-filter, reduced transparency, and motion performance.
Inventory all public, auth, dashboard, specialist, account, and shared shell routes from src/App.tsx and routeRegistry.ts.
Write VGUI-08 through VGUI-13 phase contracts, runtime state, route/effect scope, and a report that proves the new objective is planned but not yet complete.
features.evidence: VGUI-08 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-08-liquid-glass-research-baseline-and-route-plan-report.md. Strict harness validation passed with quality score 100. The source packet, phase manifest, loop state, progress log, handoff, continuity ledger, next-window prompt, and oracle were updated for VGUI-08 through VGUI-13.
features.notes: This item is the new baseline for the user request to optimize every page and effect. It is not a completion claim for VGUI-F009 through VGUI-F013.

features.description: Shared tokens, GlassSurface/Button variants, navigation/control shell, motion primitives, and reduced-preference fallbacks support the full-site Liquid Glass approximation.
steps: Implement or repair semantic Liquid Glass tokens and utilities with @supports, dark mode, reduced-transparency, and reduced-motion coverage.
Apply glass only to navigation and control layers: public nav, dashboard sidebar/top bar, search trigger, segmented controls, account trigger, and mobile bottom nav.
Capture shell evidence for public, auth, and dashboard route families on desktop and mobile.
features.evidence: VGUI-09 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-09-liquid-glass-tokens-motion-and-shell-report.md. Focused tests passed: 7 files / 17 tests. lint, i18n, and build passed. Custom shell browser matrix passed 36 checks across `/`, `/pricing`, `/login`, `/dashboard/today`, `/dashboard/chat`, and `/dashboard/settings` at desktop/mobile in normal, reduced-motion, and reduced-transparency modes.
features.notes: Shared shell implementation preserves fixed/sticky/absolute positioning and verifies reduced-transparency glass samples compute `backdrop-filter: none`. VGUI-10 must still cover all public/auth route bodies.

features.description: Home, word-of-day, demo, pricing, legal, login, register, magic link, auth callback, and onboarding surfaces use the shared Liquid Glass language without auth, legal, i18n, or billing drift.
steps: Upgrade every public and auth route within existing route labels, auth flow, and pricing fail-closed behavior.
Keep forms, legal text, and plan content on solid high-contrast surfaces while glass is limited to nav, side rails, and small controls.
Capture desktop/mobile and light/dark evidence for all public/auth routes.
features.evidence: VGUI-10 report: docs/vocabdaily-global-ui-upgrade-prd/reports/vgui-10-liquid-glass-public-auth-and-entry-surfaces-report.md. Focused public/auth tests passed: 7 files / 40 tests. lint, i18n, and build passed. Public/auth light/dark desktop/mobile matrix passed 44/44 checks at product-audit-2026-06-20/liquid-glass/vgui-10-public-auth/summary.json. Project UI regression also passed 54/54 route checks and 10/10 scenarios at product-audit-2026-06-20/liquid-glass/vgui-10-ui-regression/summary.json.
features.notes: Word-of-day, legal, pricing, sample, home, and auth/onboarding entry surfaces now use shared glass nav/control layers while route bodies remain solid. Pricing fail-closed and auth semantics are preserved; onboarding now waits for auth loading before redirect decisions.
